subject: [PATCH v5 7/8] mm/gup: walk multiple PTEs per follow_page_pte() call

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the Linux kernel's memory management by allowing multiple PTEs (Page Table Entries) to be walked in a single call to follow_page_pte(). This reduces the number of page-table descents and lock acquisitions, resulting in improved performance. The patch also introduces a new approach for handling failures during the walk, where a failure on the first PTE is returned as before, but subsequent failures end the walk and allow __get_user_pages() to retry with an error. Measurements show significant improvements in get time over 16 iterations on a 256 MB MADV_HUGEPAGE region.
